summary: AIPAC endorsed Fitzpatrick (per his campaign), and his legislative record matches that alignment: he voted Yea on all thirteen tracked Israel/Palestine floor votes in 2023–2024, including three Israel Security Supplemental Appropriations Acts and the Anti-BDS Labeling Act, co-introduced the Stand With Israel Act to confront anti-Israel bias at the UN, and led a 2023 resolution demanding Hamas' unconditional surrender. He also voted for and subsequently sponsored the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which incorporates the IHRA definition into Title VI education enforcement.
